title: rhamnus alpina subsp. glaucophylla
intro: Rhamnus alpina subsp. glaucophylla, commonly known as Alpine Buckthorn, is a plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, due to its health benefits of stimulating appetite and improving gut health. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Buckthorn include its ability to act as a laxative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, making it useful for treating constipation, wounds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Buckthorn include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
